title: fix(gates): judge a cross-package walk root against the index, not the working tree
body:
Fixes #18348

Clause-②: no

`pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` decided its walk-radius verdict from the **working tree**: a candidate walk root was admitted when `statSync` said it was a directory right now. A gitignored, possibly empty build output directory *is* a directory right now, so the verdict moved with build state — and a built worktree is the normal state for every developer and every dev agent, a fresh checkout the exception. CI stayed green only because the gate step runs in a job that builds nothing, which makes its CI verdict a function of job ordering.

The root admission now asks the **source tree**:

> A walk root is a directory git **tracks content under**. The repo root always is; every other name is judged from the index, never from `statSync`.

## Why *tracked*, and not "gitignored" or "untracked"

The card deliberately left this open. These are the readings behind the choice.

**It is a contract, not a heuristic.** This limb offers two remedies — narrow the walk, or declare the root — and "declare the root" routes a glob into turbo.json's `inputs`, where turbo hashes what git knows about. A path git does not track hashes **nothing**, so a glob declared for it closes nothing and the walk it is supposed to re-run does not exist. Both remedies void ⇒ the question is void.

**Tracked rather than "not ignored"**, because the index is what CI checks out: the local verdict and the CI verdict became the same function of the same commit, which is the asymmetry this card exists to close. Ignored is a strict subset of untracked, so the gitignored population is covered either way.

**`git check-ignore` was measured and refused on its own evidence.** On this tree, with the directory absent:

```
git check-ignore -- packages/spec/dist      exit 1   (NOT ignored)
git check-ignore -- packages/spec/dist/     exit 0   (ignored, by the packages-dist rule)
```

It answers NOT IGNORED for a directory named without a trailing separator, because the pattern that ignores it ends in one and therefore matches directories only. An on-disk-shaped answer to the very question being taken off disk.

## The census acceptance item 3 asked for, and the card recorded as not taken

Every candidate walk root the scan produces repo-wide, enumerated **ahead of** the admission filter:

| candidate roots | tracked — verdict unmoved | artefact — verdict moves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 24 | 23 | 1 |

The one artefact is the spec package's build output directory. It is proposed as a root at all only because a path handed to `JSON.stringify` inside a template literal is read as a descent entry (`packages/cli/test/init-created-files-summary.e2e.test.ts` builds a shell script that symlinks it). That misread is left standing and reported as a separate finding — see Acceptance notes.

The **other** filesystem read in this limb, `uncoveredWalkRadius`, was measured rather than assumed and is deliberately left alone: of the 13 walked roots judged on this tree, **10** are answered by the `**` shortcut without touching the filesystem at all, and the **3** that do descend are exactly the three `ACCEPTED_WALK_RADII` rows, whose radius is already non-empty by dozens of directories — an untracked directory appearing under one of them can only lengthen a list that is already accepted, never flip a verdict.

## PROBE — the regression, on a clean worktree

All three legs run at HEAD, `git status --porcelain` counted at every leg:

```
LEG 1  no packages/spec/dist                 EXIT=0   git-status-lines=0
LEG 2  mkdir -p packages/spec/dist (EMPTY)   EXIT=0   git-status-lines=0
LEG 3  rm -rf packages/spec/dist             EXIT=0   git-status-lines=0
FINAL git status lines: 0
```

Every leg prints the same line: `OK: 29 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared ... 13 walked root(s) judged, 3 on ACCEPTED_WALK_RADII.`

## Red before green, with the byte-level proof

From the committed state, the pre-fix gate was laid back down out of the merge base and read on the same tree:

```
HEAD blob (fixed gate): 8b02e2a3c8659d53ef6238c99287a00590b30ab8
BASE blob (pre-fix)   : c4a3adde1d9fda5cfecfed6a694620d5a7186004   BASE=681ebe4246
ablated blob hash     : c4a3adde1d9fda5cfecfed6a694620d5a7186004   == BASE blob
occurrences of the new predicate: 2 -> 0 after ablation, 2 again after restore

PRE-FIX gate, no build output      EXIT=0
PRE-FIX gate, EMPTY build output   EXIT=1   ⇐ the regression
    - @objectstack/cli descends a directory tree from `packages/spec/dist/`, and
FIXED  gate, the SAME empty output EXIT=0

restored blob hash: 8b02e2a3c8659d53ef6238c99287a00590b30ab8  == HEAD
git diff HEAD lines: 0        git status --porcelain lines: 0
```

## LIT CONTROL — the #15565 violation must still red, and does

Reconstructed the way the card names it: the live tree-scoped pin's folded array plus one undeclared `docs` root, nothing else.

```
mutated blob hash: 9118b671ebc4a74a86c7aea12f87b0bc0ed95a26  (HEAD was c3019404d6)
old-array occurrences 1 -> 0, injected-root occurrences 0 -> 1     (on-disk proof)

leg A  undeclared docs root, no build output      EXIT=1
       - @objectstack/spec descends a directory tree from `docs/`, and
           docs/adr/ docs/design/ docs/handoff/ docs/notes/ docs/plans/ docs/qa/ docs/screenshots/
leg B  the same violation, EMPTY build output     EXIT=1
       mentions of the artefact directory in that output: 0

restored blob hash: c3019404d6d2c51907742de2deac4a648d8d87f5 == HEAD blob
git diff HEAD lines for the pin: 0     git status --porcelain lines: 0
```

Leg B is the load-bearing pair: the #15565 red survives **and** the artefact directory is gone from the same run.

## DARK CONTROL — nothing else moved

- The gate's entire non-self-test output on a clean tree is **identical** before and after the fix, line for line (same 29 packages, same 13 walked roots, same 3 accepted radii). The only diff is the 11 added self-test lines.
- All **30** gate families `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this path exit **0**; `--ran` reconciles 30 derived / 30 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED / 0 UNRUN, as a derived zero (every family recorded its exit code).
- Repo-wide `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) exit **0**, 82s, at this head.
- `ACCEPTED_WALK_RADII` is untouched — acceptance item 4.

## The three legs are in the self-test

A new floored battery, `the WORKING-TREE blind spot (#18348)`, drives them on a real `git init` fixture: the artefact directory absent, then present and empty, then a tracked tree that must still be a root. Each leg carries its own control, including one asserting that the **on-disk predicate this replaced would have admitted** the empty directory — so the case cannot pass vacuously.

⛔ And the criterion is pinned **as a criterion, not as a name pattern**: the same directory *name*, with a file git tracks inside it, IS a judgeable root. A regex on the name would pass every other leg and fail that one. Self-test: 180 → 191 cases, `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 9 → 10.

## File surface

- `scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` — the header section stating the criterion and its measurements, `trackedDirectories()` / `trackedWalkRootDirectories()`, the root-admission filter, and the new self-test battery. **Nothing else.**

No changeset: measured, not assumed — the root manifest is `private: true` with no `files`, and no workspace package's `files[]` names a path outside its own directory, so a repo-root `scripts/` file cannot ship in any published tarball. `skip-changeset` applies.

⛔ The IMPORT-side boundary of this same script (the bare-specifier rule) is untouched — that is #18236's subject and is queued behind this card.

## Acceptance notes

Out-of-scope findings from this round, filed rather than fixed here:

- **to file (class a)** — `NON_DESCENT_CALLEES` is matched on the last dotted segment (`m[1].split('.').pop()`), so its `JSON` entry is dead: `JSON.stringify(...)` is read as a descent entry and its first argument becomes a candidate walk root. That is why the spec build output directory was ever proposed. Harmless today (the admission filter refuses it), but the same misread on a *tracked* path would produce a false red that no build state explains. Dedupe words: `NON_DESCENT_CALLEES`, `JSON.stringify`, descent callee, member call, `split('.').pop()`.
- **noted, not filed** — `check:pm-dispatch-gates` as `package.json` spells it runs its 1746-case self-test twice (once via `--self-test`, once inside the bare invocation), about 1100s total on this box against a roughly 600s foreground budget. Succeeding seat: whoever next has to measure that family locally. Not a defect, an ergonomics observation.

#18353 describes the same defect in different words and is **not addressed here** — re-grading or closing a card is the triage seat's act, not this one's.
